posts.en:
dsh-im-hub is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1c4a9e66afe82917249a.html
